source_split_policy: train clips use official MNIST train glyphs; evaluation clips use official MNIST test glyphs
assignment: one-to-one Hungarian over normalized centroid distance and bbox overlap
co_primary_endpoints: intention-to-score trajectory error with miss penalty
identity accuracy over all labelled ground-truth objects
object scoring coverage and missed/extra counts
equivalence: disabled until margins are justified from reliability and native-unit pilot data
launch_condition: authorization ledger status changed only after CPU, classifier and protocol freeze gates
